_doc: Real account layouts for the WP-09 scenario tests (src/scenarios/), read once from public RPC by `tools/capture-fixtures.py --scenarios` (spec: capture.json) and never edited: the tests mutate copies. Each account: the context slot of the getMultipleAccounts call that read it, its owner, lamports, data length, sha256 of the data (the tests check it) and the data in base64. `missing`: accounts arbx follows that did not exist (the boot treats them as absent, as on chain). `pools`: each pool with the accounts derived from it.
